name: Huan Yu Youleyuan
source:
The amusement park in the middle of the night is full of strange urban legends.
But when the group chairman's daughter, the Taoist lady, the nun, and the fox-eared girl stand in front of you at the same time to seek help, who will your body honestly choose?
As the duty of the beater, you always have to make your own choice. No matter who the outcome is, this will change your life. "Wait, do they all like COSPLAY these days?"

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2403000/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
深夜的游乐园，充满了奇异的都市传说。
但当集团董事长的女儿、道姑、尼姑、狐耳女同时站在你面前寻求帮助时，你的身体会诚实地选择谁呢？
作为击球手的职责，你总是要做出自己的选择。无论结果是谁，这都会改变你的生活。“等等，最近他们都喜欢COSPLAY吗？”

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2403000/]Steam[/url]]
